title: Promotion test
intro: Hold onto enough of your current grade and the test unlocks on its own. Pass it to open the next grade's content.
topGrade: You're already at the top grade (C2)! 🏆
comingSoon: The {grade} level-up test is coming soon.

requirements.title: Requirements — what you're holding onto at {grade}
requirements.wordsNote: A word counts once it survives its first two reviews — so far you've studied {n, plural, one {# {grade} word} other {# {grade} words}}.
requirements.keepStudying: Keep studying {grade} vocabulary and reading to fill the gauges. When every bar is full, the test opens right here.

runner.introBody: Listening ({listening}) → Reading ({questions} questions over {passages, plural, one {# passage} other {# passages}}) → Writing ({writing}, build the sentence from the words). Everything is checked instantly — no waiting. Questions are drawn at random each attempt.
runner.passRule: To pass: 70+ average with every skill at 60+. Failing is fine — practice your weakest skill and retake after {hours} hours.

result.passedBody: Test results show you're ready for {to} content.
result.promotionFailed: We couldn't apply the promotion — check your profile shortly.
result.failedTitle: Not quite yet — but you're close!

result.adjustNote: You can start with a different level — you can always level up later.
